_docs: Data-driven monster behavior tables (Steve 2026-10-07, scaffold audit). Each monster gets a behavior entry: archetype (tactical style), aggroRange/preferredRange/fleeAt (numeric tuning, currently documentary — the interpreter reads preTurnHooks for behavior), and preTurnHooks (ordered list of registered hook names run at the top of tbMonsterTurn; a hook returning true consumes the turn). To migrate a species: (1) add its hook names here, (2) register the hook functions in src/js/monsterBehaviors.js (verbatim extraction from tbMonsterTurn), (3) remove the inline branch. Behavior must be IDENTICAL — this is relocation, not redesign.

chorus_line.notes: Wave-3 signature (sigW3b, Steve 2026-10-10): visible 4/4 beat; the downbeat kicks where the line is facing. Dance, move on the beat, flank it, or break the count with gravel.

gallowdeer.notes: Highbeam Deer — the benchmark. Antlers thrash anyone adjacent every turn the beam isn't firing. BEAM-FATIGUE (2026-10-13): after 3 sterile beam declarations the deer HUNTS — a mode: every turn advances at full speed, no beams, until antler range or the trail goes cold.

heckler.notes: Renamed from hype_horn; the old hornIs crowd-deflate branch was dead code; removed 2026-10-08. Pack tactics (party-aware 2026-10-10): the set piles onto one target.

hummice.notes: Swarm self-check every turn — deaths drop voices, distance thins the hum.

hushwolf.notes: Pack tactics (party-aware 2026-10-10): flanks (+2 per wolf beside the target), runs down the isolated. Spawn scales with your party.

landlord.notes: Eviction Wall (party-splitter 2026-10-10): against 3+ fighters it rezones the ground — a telegraphed wall through the cluster, service entrance left open.

paparazzo.notes: Renamed from camera_swarm; the old swarmIs fire-scatter branch was dead code; removed 2026-10-08.

review_drone.notes: Can't grade a crowd — more live targets than crowdLimit stalls the evaluation.

reunion.notes: The village you failed, given teeth. Brings as many as you brought (mirror spawn, max 3); the faces flank and run down stragglers.

speedbump_turtle.notes: Seals in its shell and waits you out. Nearly invulnerable; the answer is patience.

spool.notes: Wave-3 signature (sigW3b, Steve 2026-10-10): RECORDS the player’s first 3 turns (harmless), then REPLAYS them back. Feed it heals and waits.

terms_of_service.notes: Wave-3 signature (sigW3b, Steve 2026-10-10): adds legible clauses mid-fight; object now, accept later, or read 3 and invoke the §0 loophole.

voice_mimic_radio.notes: The Call Goes Out (party-splitter 2026-10-10): against 3+ fighters it lures one ally off alone, once per fight. A hand on their shoulder breaks it.

redactor.notes: Point-then-redact: the handles point at a named target a full round before the redaction lands (sigW3a.js). Redacts the loudest thing first — a carried decoy absorbs it. Two quiet turns starve it.

gavel.notes: Trial procedure: accuses from the player's logged moments (a full round of warning), then the verdict falls (sigW3a.js). Object/recess/confess are real motions. Frontal strikes hit the sound-block.

focus_group.notes: Audible ratings every round: loved is buffed-and-answered, hated is safe-but-suppressed (sigW3a.js). Mouth-head parts pop; eye-heads mark. Three boring rounds and it leaves.

focus_group_eye.notes: Synthetic sub-fighter spawned by the focus group lead (sigW3a.js). Marks the player's most-used rated verb; consumes its turn. Cannot be struck down.

congregation.notes: Wave-4 signature (sigW4, Steve 2026-10-11): invite-then-absolve liturgy. Bell rings, absolution offered (heal 40 + cleanse for a 2-round geas); it cannot compel without inviting. Heresy breaks the geas.

strike.notes: Wave-4 signature (sigW4, Steve 2026-10-11): posts readable demands, then 2-round shutdowns where nothing works. Meet a demand (it leaves) or scab at half strength.

influencer.notes: Wave-4 signature (sigW4, Steve 2026-10-11): recruits literal follower adds that sharpen Ratio and drain favor. Kill followers or out-entertain it to steal them.

audit.notes: Wave-4 signature (sigW4, Steve 2026-10-11): scheduled audit every 3 rounds taxes the most-used verb for 2 rounds. Deliberate jank or read the clipboard.

reunion.notes: Wave-4 signature (sigW4, Steve 2026-10-11): mirrors your most-used verb; repeats weaken (it knows the move). Novelty is the weapon.

suburb.notes: Wave-4 signature (sigW4, Steve 2026-10-11): comfort trap. Rest heals 30 but stacks complacency (5 = you move in, routed). Escape by walking out or bring something alive inside.

eulogy.notes: Wave-4 signature (sigW4, Steve 2026-10-11): 5-verse doom narration, each verse weighted. Contradict verses to strike them; 3 contradictions unlock the kind rewrite (dismissed).

algorithm.notes: Wave-4 signature (sigW4, Steve 2026-10-11): thumbnail previews of its moves; repeats get countered (x1.5). Be unpredictable or tank on purpose to poison its data.

eater.notes: Wave-4 signature (sigW4, Steve 2026-10-11): Steve's monster. Eats grid food each round, +15 damage per 1000 kcal. Poison the meal or starve the field; it snacks packs when adjacent.

cancellation.notes: Wave-5 signature (sigW5, Steve 2026-10-11): the stamp descends 3 turns, then un-teaches System abilities and silences favor. Go off-script or spend favor.

editor.notes: Wave-5 signature (sigW5, Steve 2026-10-11): cuts every 3rd turn (turn/position/ally), telegraphed a round ahead. Cut things land on a floor tile; retrieve them or jam a cut with contradiction.

rerun.notes: Wave-5 signature (sigW5, Steve 2026-10-11): resets positions and HP every 5 rounds, +10% adaptation. Margin messages persist; win fast or write in the margins.

spoiler.notes: Wave-5 signature (sigW5, Steve 2026-10-11): truthful prophecies that gain weight; the Leaked Ending manifests through the hook. Fulfill cheaply or ask a binding question.

timeslot.notes: Wave-5 signature (sigW5, Steve 2026-10-11): 3-turn venues, strictly worsening, highlighted a round ahead. Own the venue or get bumped for being boring.

nielsen.notes: Wave-5 signature (sigW5, Steve 2026-10-11): ratings 0-100; the gaze scales with ratings and is undodgeable. At 0: 2-round sign-off. Fight boring to starve it.

finale.notes: Wave-5 signature (sigW5, Steve 2026-10-11; campaign 2026-10-12): fiFinaleHeart wraps fiFinale — part two at bloodied (sky-fall zones, the credits, accelerated growth, THE ENCORE). Declares at 50% HP or round 4; 3-round countdown to an unavoidable [150,200] title card. Sacrifice or end it first; deaths via maybeCheatDeath.

finale_crew.notes: Finale campaign node 1 (2026-10-12): the commercial break + injected spoiler/network_note trio. Standard attacks; no signature hooks.

finale_opening.notes: Finale campaign node 2 (2026-10-12): the finale still ARRIVING — same fiFinale hook, mdef overrides fiCardRange [100,140] + fiCountdownRounds 5. Kill the credits and the sky opens.

network_note.notes: Wave-5 signature (sigW5, Steve 2026-10-11): announce-then-apply memos (fragile by design). Feed it bad notes: applied next turn, reverted the turn after. Kill it first or weaponize the notes.
